historical_record.description: The Grattan Primary School, a two-storey, seventeen-room frame school with fireproof stairs, was taken over by the Board of Education; designed in the city's Bureau of Architecture, it was built by F. H. Born on a $39,200 general contract.
The Art Commission approved the Phase 3 plans for Grattan Elementary School, Project 220.
